highlights: Capital Goods 1 Export Weakness Persists; Domestic Agri & Emerging Businesses Support Growth Est.
Domestic biologicals witnessed robust growth of 45% YoY, while global biologicals revenue increased to ~Rs 60 Cr.

However, PI Industries’ CSM order book of ~US$1.25 Bn provides revenue visibility over the medium term, supported by its strong customer relationships, differentiated chemistry capabilities and innovation-led pipeline.

The company is strategically reallocating capital towards high-growth opportunities, including Pharma CRDMO and specialty electronic chemicals, with the latter targeting US$100 Mn revenue over the next 3–4 years.
valuation: Result Update 06th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 2,750 PI Industries Ltd.

The company is strategically reallocating capital towards high-growth opportunities, including Pharma CRDMO and specialty electronic chemicals, with the latter targeting US$100 Mn revenue over the next 3–4 years.

Domestic Agri, Biologicals and Pharma CRDMO are expected to provide growth support, while Specialty Electronic Chemicals is targeted to achieve US$100 Mn revenue over the next 3–4 years, with a meaningful ramp-up expected from FY28.
watch: Sector Outlook: Cautious • Company Outlook: Management has revised its FY27 outlook to flattish revenue growth, reflecting continued weakness in agrochemical exports and near-term pricing pressures, which are expected to persist over the next couple of quarters.

Despite near-term profitability pressures from elevated input costs and investments in new businesses, PI Industries’ strong CSM order book, robust net cash position and innovation-led pipeline underpin its long-term growth outlook. • Current Valuation: 28x Sep’28E (Earlier Valuation: 28x FY28E) Current TP: Rs. 2,750/share (Earlier TP: Rs 3,045/share) Recommendation: We maintain our BUY rating on the stock.
